title: PNPD Bug Forecast Report
description: Schema contract for PNPD Bug Forecast Reports, the first future structured output format for Skeptic-style adversarial review. Findings are advisory only and do not authorize implementation, merge, deploy, dispatch, or certification.

schemaVersion.description: Schema version for the bug forecast report format.

artifactType.description: Artifact type identifier. Must be bug-forecast-report.

producedBy.description: Producer of this forecast. Skeptic is the primary future producer, but Codex or manual review may produce equivalent adversarial forecasts before executable Skeptic exists.

createdAt.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when this forecast report was created.

phaseId.description: PNPD phase identifier for the phase this forecast was produced in.

projectId.description: Project identifier this forecast applies to.

commit.description: Full 40-character git commit SHA this forecast targets. Short SHA is forbidden.

phase.description: PNPD phase identifier of the target phase being reviewed.

component.description: Specific component or file area under review.

artifactKind.description: Kind of artifact being reviewed. Forecast does not certify any artifact kind.

paths.description: File paths covered by this forecast review.

forecastScope.description: Brief description of what this forecast covers and its boundaries.

findings.description: Advisory findings from the forecast review. A zero-finding report is allowed only when summary.totalFindings is 0.

id.description: Bug forecast finding identifier in BF-NNNN format.

title.description: Short descriptive title of the finding.

severity.description: Severity of the finding. Measures impact, not certainty. Blocker severity requires Owner review, not automatic blocking.

confidence.description: How confident the producer is in this finding. Measures evidence strength.

falsePositiveLikelihood.description: Estimated likelihood this finding is a false positive. Measures uncertainty.

claim.description: The claim or assumption being challenged by this finding.

forecast.description: The forecasted risk or defect scenario if this finding is not addressed.

evidenceRefs.description: References to evidence entries supporting this finding, by evidence id.

affectedAreas.description: Areas of the project affected by this finding.

recommendedReviewer.description: Recommended agent or human role to review this finding.

recommendedNextAction.description: Recommended next action for the reviewer. Advisory only.

status.description: Current status of the finding. Resolution or authority-conferring statuses are intentionally excluded from the enum.

totalFindings.description: Total number of findings in this report.

evidenceGapCount.description: Count of findings classified as evidence gaps.

ownerReviewRequired.description: Whether any finding in this report requires Owner review.

codexReviewRecommended.description: Whether Codex review is recommended for any finding in this report.

evidence.description: Evidence references supporting the forecast findings. Must not contain secrets, credentials, personal data, production customer data, live payment data, bank data, healthcare data, regulated finance production data, or .env contents.

id.description: Unique identifier for this evidence reference.

path.description: File path for this evidence reference.

lineStart.description: Starting line number referenced in the evidence.

lineEnd.description: Ending line number referenced in the evidence.

excerpt.description: Optional short excerpt from the evidence. Must not contain secrets or sensitive data.

hash.description: Content hash for integrity verification of the referenced evidence.

notes.description: Additional notes about this evidence reference.

limitations.description: Known limitations of this forecast review, including scope boundaries and untested areas.

advisoryOnly.description: This artifact is advisory only. It does not authorize any action.

doesNotAuthorize.description: List of actions this artifact explicitly does not authorize.

requiresOwnerReview.description: Whether Owner review is required before any downstream action.

requiresCodexReview.description: Whether Codex review is recommended before any downstream action.

generatedByAi.description: Whether this forecast was generated by an AI agent.

humanReviewed.description: Whether a human has reviewed this forecast. false does not invalidate the artifact; it only records review state.

redactionApplied.description: Whether sensitive data redaction was applied to this report.

containsSensitiveData.description: Must be false. Bug forecast reports must not contain sensitive data.

sensitiveDataPolicy.description: Policy applied to ensure no sensitive data is present in this report.
